_comment: IronMonkey persona manifest (Phase 2 step H11 schema, v1). NOT read by
Conpot -- the forwarder reads it to stamp asset_type/vendor/model on
every event; those three fields seed the uuid5 of the x-ics-asset node.
This persona is the DACH regional VARIANT of s7-315-substation (step
H13, Decision 19, the Western Europe sensor). `variant_of` and `region`
are informational: the forwarder ignores them, and the unified registry
repeats them so its sector-uniqueness check can exempt a variant from
the one-persona-per-sector rule while still requiring every device
identity below to be distinct from the base persona's.
Why a CPU 317 and not a second 315: two personas sharing vendor+model on
any protocol merge two sensors' devices into one graph identity (see
asset_type must stay inside the enum in ironmonkey-unified/shared/
own data_type values, not port names; `default` covers the rest.
label: 110/20 kV Umspannwerk (DACH), Siemens S7-317-2 PN/DP with IEC 60870-5-104 telecontrol
